scenarios.requirement: Pull every runtime image from its public registry and launch the server by immutable repository digest.
Accept through the shared endpoint, claim through API node A, complete through API node B, and describe completion through the shared endpoint.

Abruptly terminate one API node while an acknowledged workflow-task lease is live, preserve an identity-matching nonterminal run description through the shared endpoint, then complete the same lease through the survivor before its advertised expiry.

Readiness and writes fail during database loss; after bounded recovery, an identity-matching nonterminal run description remains and the workflow completes exactly once through either the live claimant or a bounded replacement reclaim after proving the expired owner is fenced.
Readiness reports the acceleration layer as warning, request-ID polling falls back to durable discovery without duplicate leases, and discovery after Redis return is measured.

Abandon a leased workflow task, preserve an identity-matching canonical nonterminal run description, reclaim under a different worker only after lease expiry, and complete exactly once without changing workflow input or history.
Stop the only scheduler before a durable schedule is due, observe no fire while stopped, restart it, and observe exactly one fire within the configured bound.
